title: The Close-Quarters Knife Course
summary: Trains qi-aided knife work inside arm's reach where long weapons cannot swing and only the short blade counts.

title: Knife and Open Hand Exercises
summary: Teaches the free hand to feint trap and cover while the knife hand cuts behind it.

title: A Practical Guide to Knife Entries
summary: Shows how to enter a stronger opponent's guard with a short blade and qi-driven footwork.

title: The Hunter's Knife in Close Pursuit
summary: Adapts the finishing and tracking skills of hunters to knife duels and running fights.

title: Complete Forms of the Working Knife
summary: Sets out ten numbered forms of the working knife from plain cuts to qi-backed finishing blows.

title: Lessons on Edge and Spine
summary: Teaches students to use the blunt spine for control and the edge for cutting in turn.

title: The Cook-Knife Manual of Fast Hands
summary: Turns the rapid rhythmic cuts of a kitchen knife into quick qi-backed flurries.

title: Guard-Breaking with the Short Blade
summary: Explains how a short knife can break open a held guard and strip a weapon.

title: A Course in Chaining Knife Cuts
summary: Builds cuts into linked chains that carry qi from one stroke to the next without pause.

title: Reading the Opponent's Hand with the Knife
summary: Trains the student to read an opponent's grip and wrist and punish each weakness with the blade.
